# 本業瓔珞經疏

**ID:** T2798
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 律部類,敦煌寫本部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2798

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle commentary fragment on the *Púsà yīngluò běnyè jīng* ([KR6k0105](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0105)), preserved at Dunhuang and included in volume 85 of the Taishō (the *Gǔyìbù* 古逸部 "old/lost works").

**Abstract**

The fragment is one of the Dunhuang Buddhist commentary fragments in Taishō volume 85, attesting to active engagement with the *Yīngluò běnyè jīng* in northwestern Tang Buddhist communities. Like the parallel *Fànwǎngjīng shùjì* fragment ([KR6k0104](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0104)), the fragmentary state limits utility but valuable as a witness to lost commentary traditions.
